custom_description:
Greenhouse is an applicant tracking system (ATS) that helps companies manage their
hiring process via the Harvest v3 API with OAuth 2.0 authentication. This connector
provides access to candidates, applications, jobs, offers, users, departments,
offices, job posts, sources, and interviews for recruiting analytics and talent
acquisition insights.
supported_questions:
- List all open jobs
- Show me recent interviews
- Show me recent job offers
- List recent applications
- Show me candidates from {company} who applied last month
- What are the top 5 sources for our job applications this quarter?
- Analyze the interview schedules for our engineering candidates this week
- Compare the number of applications across different offices
- Identify candidates who have multiple applications in our system
- Summarize the candidate pipeline for our latest job posting
- Find the most active departments in recruiting this month

fields.name: agency_note_id
fields.description: Id of the note created when the candidate was submitted by an agency, or `null` if the application did not come through an agency.

fields.name: answers
fields.description: Free-text answers the candidate provided on the job post application form. Each entry pairs the question text with the candidate's answer.

fields.name: candidate_id
fields.description: Id of the candidate (person) this application belongs to.

fields.name: coordinator_id
fields.description: Id of the user assigned as coordinator on the application's job, or `null` when unassigned.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 applications record.

fields.name: custom_fields
fields.description: Org-defined custom fields keyed by the field's `name_key`. Each value carries the field's display `name`, its `type`, and its `value`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 applications record.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Id of the job this application is on. `null` for jobless prospect applications.

fields.name: job_interview_stage_id
fields.description: Id of the job interview stage definition (see `GET /v3/job_interview_stages`) the candidate is currently in for this application. `null` for prospect applications and applications in a terminal state.

fields.name: job_post_id
fields.description: Id of the job post the candidate applied through, or `null` if the application was created internally rather than from a posted role.

fields.name: last_activity_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity on this application (notes, emails, stage changes, etc.), in ISO 8601.

fields.name: location_address
fields.description: Free-form location string captured on the application (typically from the job post's location question).

fields.name: needs_decision
fields.description: `true` when the application is waiting on a hiring-team decision (scorecard completion, advance/reject, etc.) in its current stage.

fields.name: prospect
fields.description: `true` for prospect applications (sourced candidates not yet attached to a single job), `false` for candidate applications on a specific job.

fields.name: prospective_job_ids
fields.description: For prospect applications, the ids of jobs the prospect is being considered for. Empty for non-prospect applications and for jobless prospects.

fields.name: recruiter_id
fields.description: Id of the user assigned as recruiter on the application's job, or `null` when unassigned.

fields.name: referrer_id
fields.description: Id of the referrer who credited this application, or `null` if there was no referral. References a referrer, not a Greenhouse user.

fields.name: rejected_at
fields.description: Timestamp the application was rejected, in ISO 8601. `null` for applications that have not been rejected.

fields.name: rejection_reason_id
fields.description: Id of the rejection reason selected for the application. References a `/v3/rejection_reasons` row scoped to the organization. `null` when the application was rejected without a reason, or has not been rejected.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Id of the source the application is attributed to (e.g. a job board, an event, an employee referral source). `null` if no source is set.

fields.name: stage_id
fields.description: Id of the interview stage the candidate is currently in for this application. `null` for prospect applications and applications in a terminal state.

fields.name: stage_name
fields.description: Display name of the candidate's current interview stage on this application.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the application. `in_process` for active candidates, `rejected` for rejected applications, `hired` once an offer is closed and the hire endpoint has fired, and `converted` for prospect applications that have been promoted to a candidate application via `convert_to_candidate`.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 applications record.

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: Postal addresses on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `home`, `work`, or `other`.

fields.name: can_email
fields.description: Whether this candidate has consented to receive email communication from your organization.

fields.name: company
fields.description: Candidate's current company, as entered on their profile.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 candidates record.

fields.name: custom_fields
fields.description: Org-defined custom fields keyed by the field's `name_key`. Each value carries the field's display `name`, its `type`, and its `value`.

fields.name: email_addresses
fields.description: Email addresses on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `personal`, `work`, or `other`.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: First name from the Greenhouse v3 candidates record.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 candidates record.

fields.name: last_activity_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity on any of the candidate's applications (notes, emails, stage changes, etc.), in ISO 8601.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Last name from the Greenhouse v3 candidates record.

fields.name: linked_user_ids
fields.description: Ids of Greenhouse users linked to this candidate (employees represented by both a user record and a candidate record).

fields.name: phone_numbers
fields.description: Phone numbers on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `mobile`, `home`, `work`, `skype`, or `other`.

fields.name: preferred_name
fields.description: Preferred or chosen name the candidate goes by, when different from their legal first name.

fields.name: private
fields.description: If true, the candidate is restricted to users with `View Private Candidates` access. Defaults to `false`.

fields.name: social_media_addresses
fields.description: Social media handles or URLs on the candidate's profile. Social entries are untyped — only the `value` is returned.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Candidate tag names applied to this candidate within your organization.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.description: Candidate's time zone as a Rails-style identifier (for example `Eastern Time (US & Canada)`).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Candidate's current job title, as entered on their profile.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 candidates record.

fields.name: website_addresses
fields.description: Personal websites or portfolio URLs on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `personal`, `company`, `portfolio`, `blog`, or `other`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 departments record.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Partner-supplied identifier for the department, typically the matching id from an HRIS or other external system. Free-form string and `null` when no external id has been set.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 departments record.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the department (e.g. `Engineering`, `Marketing`).

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Id of the parent department in the organization's department tree. `null` for top-level departments. References another `/v3/departments` row.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 departments record.

fields.name: active
fields.description: If `true`, the post has not been deleted. Deleted posts are excluded by default; pass `active=false` on the list endpoint to retrieve them.

fields.name: content
fields.description: HTML body of the post shown to candidates on the job board. For internal posts this returns the `internal_content` instead. Sanitized server-side — only a limited element/attribute allowlist (including `iframe`, `video`, `source`) survives. `null` while the post is still being scaffolded.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 job posts record.

fields.name: demographic_question_set_id
fields.description: Id of the demographic question set surfaced to candidates on this post for diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) reporting. `null` when the post does not collect demographic data.

fields.name: featured
fields.description: If `true`, the post is currently featured on the organization's internal job board and surfaces in the weekly internal-jobs email. Only internal posts can be featured, and at most three can be featured at a time.

fields.name: first_published_at
fields.description: Timestamp the post first transitioned to `live`, in ISO 8601. `null` for posts that have never been published.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 job posts record.

fields.name: internal
fields.description: If `true`, the post lives on an internal job board and is visible only to existing employees signed in to the internal board. If `false`, the post is external and lives on a public-facing `job_board`. Set by the board the post is associated with at create time.

fields.name: internal_content
fields.description: HTML body shown on the internal job board when the post is also configured as internal. `null` for external-only posts. Same sanitization rules as `content`.

fields.name: job_board_id
fields.description: Id of the `job_board` this post is published to. Resolves to either an external (careers site, syndicated board) or internal job board depending on `internal`. Each post belongs to exactly one board at a time.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Id of the parent job (requisition) this post belongs to. A single job can have multiple posts; the job is the source of truth for the hiring team, openings, and interview plan.

fields.name: language
fields.description: ISO 639-1 locale of the post, used to render the candidate-facing application form in the matching language (e.g. `en`, `fr`, `ja`). `null` when no locale has been chosen.

fields.name: live
fields.description: If `true`, the post is published (`job_application_status` is `live`) and its job board is also live. A post on an unpublished board is **not** `live` — its `public_url` returns a 404 until the board is enabled.

fields.name: public_url
fields.description: Canonical public URL of the post on its job board, including the `gh_jid` tracking parameter. `null` when the post has no associated job board or the board has no public URL configured.

fields.name: questions
fields.description: Application form questions presented to candidates on this post, including default questions (resume, cover letter, basic info) and any custom questions configured by the hiring team. Ordered as they appear on the form.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Public-facing title shown to candidates on the job board (e.g. `Senior Backend Engineer, Remote`). Distinct from the internal `job.name` — a single job can have several posts with different titles, one per board, language, or geography.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 job posts record.

semantic_fields.name: content
semantic_fields.description: HTML body of the post shown to candidates on the job board. For internal posts this returns the `internal_content` instead. Sanitized server-side — only a limited element/attribute allowlist (including `iframe`, `video`, `source`) survives. `null` while the post is still being scaffolded.

semantic_fields.name: internal_content
semantic_fields.description: HTML body shown on the internal job board when the post is also configured as internal. `null` for external-only posts. Same sanitization rules as `content`.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: Timestamp the job most recently transitioned to `closed`, in ISO 8601. `null` for jobs that are still `open` or `draft`.

fields.name: confidential
fields.description: If `true`, the job is restricted to users explicitly granted access on the Hiring Team. The legacy Confidential Jobs feature has been sunset — this flag cannot be set on new jobs and is preserved for jobs that already had it enabled.

fields.name: copied_from_id
fields.description: Id of the job (typically a template) this job was copied from on creation. `null` when the job was not created from another job.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 jobs record.

fields.name: custom_fields
fields.description: Org-defined custom fields keyed by the field's `name_key`. Each value carries the field's display `name`, its `type`, and its `value`.

fields.name: department_id
fields.description: Id of the department this job is assigned to. `null` when no department is set.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 jobs record.

fields.name: is_template
fields.description: If `true`, this job is a template used as the source for new jobs rather than a real requisition. Templates do not accept applications; reference them via `template_job_id` on `POST /v3/jobs`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Internal job title shown to the hiring team in Greenhouse (e.g. `Senior Backend Engineer`). Distinct from the external-facing title on each `job_post`.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Internal HTML notes about the job, surfaced to the hiring team in the Greenhouse UI. Not exposed on public job posts.

fields.name: office_ids
fields.description: Ids of the offices this job is assigned to. A job can span multiple offices; empty array or `null` when no offices are set.

fields.name: opened_at
fields.description: Timestamp the job first transitioned to `open`, in ISO 8601. `null` while the job is still in `draft`.

fields.name: requisition_id
fields.description: Partner-supplied external identifier for the requisition (e.g. an HRIS or ATS code). Free-form string, not unique across the organization, and `null` when no external id has been set.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the job. `draft` while it is being scaffolded, `open` once it has at least one open opening, and `closed` after every opening is closed. A job moves to `closed` automatically when its last open opening is closed via `PATCH /v3/openings/{id}`.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 jobs record.

semantic_fields.name: notes
semantic_fields.description: Internal HTML notes about the job, surfaced to the hiring team in the Greenhouse UI. Not exposed on public job posts.

fields.name: application_id
fields.description: Id of the application this offer is extended on. Every offer belongs to exactly one application; the offer is voided if the application is rejected or deleted.

fields.name: candidate_id
fields.description: Id of the candidate (person) receiving this offer. Resolved through the offer's application.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 offers record.

fields.name: custom_fields
fields.description: Org-defined custom fields keyed by the field's `name_key`. Each value carries the field's display `name`, its `type`, and its `value`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 offers record.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Id of the job this offer's application is on.

fields.name: opening_id
fields.description: Id of the specific opening this offer is being extended for. `null` when the offer has not yet been linked to an opening.

fields.name: resolved_at
fields.description: Timestamp the offer was resolved (`Accepted` or `Rejected`), in ISO 8601. Date updates submitted through `PATCH /v3/offers/{id}` are normalized to noon UTC on the supplied date. `null` while the offer is still `Created` or has been superseded as `Deprecated` without a resolution.

fields.name: sent_on
fields.description: Date the offer was sent to the candidate, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). `null` until the offer has been sent.

fields.name: starts_on
fields.description: Candidate's proposed start date, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). `null` when no start date has been set on the offer.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the offer. `Created` for offers still being drafted or pending approval, `Accepted` once the candidate accepts, `Rejected` if declined or withdrawn, and `Deprecated` for superseded prior versions (a new offer version replaces an earlier one with this status).

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 offers record.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Revision number of this offer within its application. Greenhouse creates a new offer row (incrementing `version`) whenever a tracked field on an existing offer changes — typically `starts_on`, `opening_id`, or a custom field configured to trigger a new version. Pair with `current_only=true` to filter the list endpoint down to the latest version per application.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 offices record.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Stable identifier supplied by the customer or HRIS for cross-system reconciliation. `null` when no external id has been set. Available when the `org_structure_external_id` product flag is enabled.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 offices record.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Free-form physical location string for the office (e.g. `New York, NY, USA`). `null` for offices that have no location set, including most remote offices.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the office (e.g. `San Francisco`, `Remote (US)`). Unique among active offices in the same organization.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Id of the parent office when offices are organized hierarchically. `null` for top-level offices. References another `/v3/offices` row in the same organization.

fields.name: primary_in_house_contact_user_id
fields.description: Id of the Greenhouse user designated as the office's primary internal contact, typically the local recruiting lead. References a `/v3/users` row. `null` when no contact has been assigned.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 offices record.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 sources record.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 sources record.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the source as recruiters see it in Greenhouse (e.g. `LinkedIn (Prospecting)`, `Indeed`, `Referral`, `Internal Applicant`, or a custom agency name). For organization-specific sources this is the label the org configured; for global Greenhouse sources it is the standard public name.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The sourcing strategy this source rolls up to — the broader category used for reporting. Sources are grouped under sourcing strategies such as `Agencies`, `Referral`, `Third-party boards`, `Prospecting`, `Social media`, `Company marketing`, `In person event`, `MyGreenhouse`, and `Other`. Use the strategy when aggregating candidate volume by channel; use the source itself when reporting on a specific channel within that category.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 sources record.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: Id of the staffing agency this user belongs to, when the user is an external agency recruiter rather than an employee of your organization. `null` for in-house users.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Created at from the Greenhouse v3 users record.

fields.name: custom_fields
fields.description: Org-defined custom fields keyed by the field's `name_key`. Each value carries the field's display `name`, its `type`, and its `value`.

fields.name: deactivated
fields.description: Whether the user has been deactivated. Deactivated users cannot sign in or be assigned to new jobs, but their historical activity (notes, scorecards, emails) is preserved. Toggle via `POST /v3/users/{id}/deactivate` and `POST /v3/users/{id}/activate`.

fields.name: department_ids
fields.description: Ids of the departments this user is assigned to. Used to scope future job permissions and to filter the user list by department. Empty when the user is not pinned to any department.

fields.name: emails
fields.description: All email addresses on the user's account, including the primary address and any additional verified addresses.

fields.name: employee_id
fields.description: Partner-supplied external employee identifier, typically the user's HRIS or payroll id. Free-form string; not unique across organizations and `null` when no employee id has been set.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: First name from the Greenhouse v3 users record.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id from the Greenhouse v3 users record.

fields.name: interviewer_tags
fields.description: Interviewer tags applied to this user — the labeled skill or panel groupings (e.g. `Senior Engineer`, `Bar Raiser`) used to suggest qualified interviewers when building an interview plan. Each entry pairs the tag's `id` with its `name`.

fields.name: job_title
fields.description: Free-form job title set on the user's Greenhouse profile (e.g. `Senior Recruiter`). Not synchronized with any HRIS title.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Last name from the Greenhouse v3 users record.

fields.name: linked_candidate_ids
fields.description: Ids of candidate records linked to this user. Populated when an employee is represented by both a user record (for Greenhouse access) and a candidate record (for past or internal applications).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Concatenation of `first_name` and `last_name` rendered as a single display string. Provided for convenience; partners that need either component should read `first_name`/`last_name` directly.

fields.name: office_ids
fields.description: Ids of the offices this user is assigned to. Used to scope future job permissions and to filter the user list by office. Empty when the user is not pinned to any office.

fields.name: primary_email
fields.description: Primary email address on the user's account. Sign-in identifier and the address Greenhouse uses for outbound mail; additional verified addresses are not surfaced here. Service accounts (integration/ISU users) have no email and are excluded from this endpoint by default; when included via `show_service_accounts=true`, their `primary_email` is an empty string.

fields.name: site_admin
fields.description: Whether the user holds the Site Admin role. Site admins have unrestricted access to every non-confidential job and to organization-level settings. Demote a site admin to a Basic user with `POST /v3/users/{id}/revoke_permissions`.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Updated at from the Greenhouse v3 users record.
